34: // AddToManager adds the webhook to the given manager.
35: func AddToManager(mgr manager.Manager) error {
36: 	webhook := &admission.Webhook{
37: 		Handler: NewHandler(
38: 			mgr.GetAPIReader(),
39: 			mgr.GetClient(),
40: 			admission.NewDecoder(mgr.GetScheme()),

42: 		RecoverPanic: ptr.To(true),
43: 	}
44: 
45: 	mgr.GetWebhookServer().Register(WebhookPath, webhook)
46: 	return nil
47: }

49: // NewHandler returns a new handler for validating audit policies.
50: func NewHandler(apiReader, c client.Reader, decoder admission.Decoder) admission.Handler {
51: 	return &configvalidator.Handler{
52: 		APIReader: apiReader,
53: 		Client:    c,
54: 		Decoder:   decoder,
55: 
56: 		ConfigMapPurpose: "audit policy",
57: 		ConfigMapDataKey: "policy",
58: 		GetConfigMapNameFromShoot: func(shoot *gardencore.Shoot) string {
59: 			return gardencorehelper.GetShootAuditPolicyConfigMapName(shoot.Spec.Kubernetes.KubeAPIServer)
60: 		},
61: 		AdmitConfig: admitConfig,
62: 	}
63: }
64: 
65: var decoder runtime.Decoder
66: 
67: func init() {
68: 	scheme := runtime.NewScheme()
69: 	schemeBuilder := runtime.NewSchemeBuilder(auditv1.AddToScheme, audit.AddToScheme)
70: 	utilruntime.Must(schemeBuilder.AddToScheme(scheme))
71: 	decoder = serializer.NewCodecFactory(scheme).UniversalDecoder()
72: }
73: 
74: func admitConfig(auditPolicyRaw string, _ []*gardencore.Shoot) (int32, error) {
75: 	obj, schemaVersion, err := decoder.Decode([]byte(auditPolicyRaw), nil, nil)
76: 	if err != nil {
77: 		return http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode the provided audit policy: %w", err)
78: 	}
79: 
80: 	auditPolicy, ok := obj.(*audit.Policy)
81: 	if !ok {
82: 		return http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Errorf("failed to cast to audit policy type: %v", schemaVersion)
83: 	}
84: 
85: 	if errList := auditvalidation.ValidatePolicy(auditPolicy); len(errList) != 0 {
86: 		return http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, fmt.Errorf("provided invalid audit policy: %v", errList)
87: 	}
88: 
89: 	return 0, nil
90: }
